name: autonomous_mission
description: Runs Brahma Evo goals in isolated external worker processes for an exact duration or until a verifiable completion condition is met. Durable mission state, absolute deadlines, worker heartbeats, cancellation flags, and hidden Windows recovery tasks allow missions to resume after Brahma restarts and system reboot without claiming work happened while the machine was offline.

action.description: Action: start, list, status, cancel, recover.

goal.description: The full task Brahma should work on.

duration.description: Maximum runtime such as 15 seconds, 5 minutes, 24 hours, or 24h 5m. Maximum 30 days.

until.description: Optional natural-language completion condition, for example 'the bug is fixed and tests pass'.

completion_type.description: Optional completion strategy: agent_success, phrase, file_exists, regex, process_gone, memory_below.

completion_target.description: Target for the selected completion strategy, such as a file path, regex, process name/PID, or memory percentage.

interval_seconds.description: Low-power wait between autonomous iterations; default 30 seconds.

keep_working.description: When true, continue iterating after an apparently successful attempt until the duration or completion condition is reached.
